resources.string: This audio output does not support the boost effect. Try a different output.
Android blocked the boost service. Open the panel and try again.
Notifications are off. Return to this panel to stop the boost.
High volume can damage your hearing and speakers. Start with low volume. Even a small boost can cause distortion.
If boost is active when you turn off your device, it may resume at the next startup. Tap Stop before turning off your device to prevent this.
Gain above %1$d%% increases the risk of hearing and speaker damage. No level is guaranteed safe.
